The Law and Society
program
will allow students to explore the
relationships between laws, courts, and other social institutions, such as
economics, politics, family, health and technology, and morality. The program
combines both theoretical and applied analyses of law and legal processes so
that you will emerge with a deep understanding of the role of law in our
day-to-day lives.
